name: Surprise bill or fee

queries: {country} billing transparency unfair fee rule {sector} regulator
{company} surprise fee billing complaint similar resolved case

evaluationPrompt: Determine whether the disputed charge matches the published tariff or contract. Check whether the fee was disclosed before purchase. Check whether a sector regulator rule covers notice or caps. Return findings with source IDs and supporting passages.
compensationLogic: Refund comes from the disputed amount in the facts and any fee cap or refund rule found in the sources; no amounts are estimated from memory.
letterTemplate: The disputed charge, the mismatch with the quoted price or tariff with citation, the amount requested back, and a deadline.

IN: Internal grievance officer / nodal officer where required
EU: Sector regulator or national enforcement body
European Consumer Centre / alternative dispute resolution
US: Sector regulator (e.g. FCC, CFPB, state utility commission)
Better Business Bureau / state attorney general
